tasks.label: func: stop existing
tasks.command: $connections = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5678,7071 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $connections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0

tasks.label: func: host start
tasks.command: Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned; & "${workspaceFolder}\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1"; func host start --verbose

background.endsPattern: Worker process started and initialized|Host lock lease acquired
